future_check: Monitor held-out performance before expanding beyond 6x6; require continued per-band 3x3 support and 30x30 output safety.
rationale: The previous median area near 63 drifted far from the canonical 3x3 task and inflated outputs. The new range adds useful rectangular and longer-trail variation without approaching ARC output bounds.
summary: The repaired distribution stays within 3..6 inputs while anchoring 3x3 canonical scale in every band.

future_check: If collision cases are ever added as a real branch, first specify overwrite order in learner-facing semantics and add positive collision witnesses rather than broadening self_check alone.
rationale: Distinct diagonals make every source consequence visible and avoid ambiguous occlusion pedagogy. The isolated recombination probe proves self_check rejects an otherwise-lawful scene when one source is moved onto another source diagonal.
summary: Ordinary training scenes intentionally put sources on distinct r-c diagonals even though the oracle has defined first-hit behavior when trails collide.

future_check: Keep at least one interior source in every four-demo lesson and retain explicit top-row-only and top/left-edge-only rival checks.
rationale: Canonical inputs include interior evidence, and the repaired interior_mix branch gives ordinary positive witnesses with sources away from both the top row and left edge. Top-only and edge-only rivals are therefore refuted rather than silently taught.
summary: The task is not limited to top-row or left-edge source cells.

future_check: After any schedule edit, resample sliding four-example windows and require canonical/broad scale, mixed_edges/interior_mix, source counts 2/3/4, and all named rivals to remain covered.
rationale: The old independent-axis sampler made lesson composition accidental and left shortcut rules reliable. A deterministic four-slot schedule makes the minimum lesson itself identify the southeast-extension rule.
summary: Every four-example lesson window deliberately covers canonical scale, broader scale, both placement branches, and 2/3/4-source cases.

future_check: Run selected-exact synchronization plus execution parity after any edit to canonical, target_code, raw_code, or RULE_HASH.
rationale: Overwriting archival raw text would destroy provenance, while leaving the selected target divergent causes rebuild and authority ambiguity. Role metadata separates those responsibilities without weakening execution checks.
summary: The task-local selected target now exactly matches canonical Racket text; the behavior-equivalent archival raw source remains explicitly labeled and parity-checked.
